periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Primary axis of both eye patches is angled downward and outward at approximately 40 to 45 degrees relative to the horizontal facial midline.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated teardrop shape where the vertical dimension is significantly greater than the horizontal width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Distinct tapering at the inferior-lateral margin, creating a pointed downward effect.

dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: The black band is thick, occupying approximately 40% of the visible torso height from the shoulder to the bamboo obstruction.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide lateral spacing between pinnae, approximately 2.5 times the width of an individual pinna.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Convex and rounded at the apex with a slightly irregular perimeter due to dense fur texture.

other_distinctive_markers: Significant yellowish-brown discoloration of the ventral fur compared to the high-white cranial fur.
